anaglyph_description: Splits one camera image into two adjustable colour channels. Separation is measured at the final output resolution.
custom_file: Edit Data/Shaders/NightEye/CustomVFX.hlsli, then reload the shader.
eye_compatibility: Affects human and creature eye meshes, plus supported creature body atlases. Custom combined meshes need an eyeshine mask.
geometry.available: Eyeshine and actor vision shader support is available.
geometry.fallback: Some graphics shaders fell back to their original version. Eyeshine or actor vision may be incomplete. Check NightEye.log for details.
geometry.partial: Some installed graphics shaders are unsupported. Eyeshine and actor vision may be incomplete. Check NightEye.log for details.
geometry.unavailable: Eyeshine and actor vision are unavailable with the installed graphics shaders. Check NightEye.log for details.
language.name: English
menu_description: This window controls the Night Eye addon. Changes take effect immediately; Save keeps them for the next game launch.
settings.load_failed: Saved settings could not be loaded. Defaults restored. Check NightEye.log for details.
settings.reset_done: Defaults restored. Save to keep these settings.
settings.save_failed: Settings could not be saved. Check NightEye.log for details.
shader.failed: The shader did not compile. Correct the file and reload. The previous shader is retained when available. Check NightEye.log for details.
shader.waiting: Waiting to prepare the Night Eye shader.
vision_description: Highlights visible living actors using their game relationships, including modded creatures. Predator uses the editable relationship colours; Infrared Style uses simulated heat colours. Global tint is bypassed while actor vision is enabled.
window.title: Truly Night Eye
